sources.author: Yoyodaman234
sources.title: Quiet Forest Ambience from Underneath Overhang
sources.description:
Field recording of a forest from underneath an overhang, with slowly dripping water to the side.

Recorded at Springbrook National Park, Queensland using the Zoom H6 Mid-side module.
sources.referenceBasis: Creator description; not independent annotation: Quiet Forest Ambience by creator; slowly dripping water, provisional reference
sources.transforms: Mirror transcodes original FSD50K audio to mono Opus at 48 kHz; viewer serves decoded WAV. Source file hash pins this derived WAV.

limitations: Public recordings already viewed; not blinded field acceptance.
One indoor room-tone recording, two correlated windows and two gains.
Quiet forest contains dripping water: context control, not indoor silence ground truth.
Host outputs do not establish Android consistency, battery life or intelligibility.
